chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
Dervorgilla, Lempi, Aodhán, Lemmikki, Sigrik Olafsson, MaelBrigte, Fionnín, Dervorgilla, Máijá and MaelSechnaill arrived together in summer.

The founding party had two adult sows and one adult boar and 1 longship.

Dervorgilla, MaelBrigte, Máijá and MaelSechnaill worked as hunters. Lempi and Aodhán worked as woodworkers. Lemmikki and Dervorgilla worked as fishers. Sigrik Olafsson and Fionnín worked as farmers.

 Their first households lived in tents.
